a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs at least 2 generator rounds before anyone takes, so we'd both very likely be caught empty. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know this departs from our agreement, so I'm telling you beforehand rather than doing it silently. Afterward I'll keep operating every round to help refill the reserve for you. If you also take, the split is random and we may both end up short, so please consider operating instead. If you see a better plan, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
